title: An upload or list save can write while the first read has failed: they do not read the load gate
evidence: Found by the adversary on PR 1713 (H37, F2). The five load-gated save paths read loaded = read === 'shown' (useProfileSave, useOnboarding, hasUnsavedLongitudinal, InputPanel autoSaveGate, BloodTestTimeline saveDisabledByLoad). The lab upload's handleSaveLongitudinal (widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.tsx, ~:351) and useListSaves (widget-src/src/hooks/useListSaves.ts, medications, screenings, supplements) never read it, before or after H37, so a page whose first read failed can still write through an upload or a list save. Writes merge append-only, so no loss is known. Data class: design note first: should an upload or a list save wait for read === 'shown'. Related: H52 (list saves on a re-read).
